newsitem.title: USA: Hayes Wheels to acquire Lemmerz Holding.
newsitem.headline: Hayes Wheels to acquire Lemmerz Holding.

text.p: Hayes Wheels International Inc, an automotive wheel and brake product supplier, said Friday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Lemmerz Holding GmbH, a European full-line wheel supplier, in a cash and stock transaction valued at about $390 million.

Under the agreement, shareholders of Lemmerz will receive $200 million in cash and shares of Hayes preferred stock, which will be convertible into five million shares of Hayes common stock, Hayes said.
Hayes will also refinance about $80 million of Lemmerz's existing debt.
The cash portion of the purchase price will be financed through Hayes's senior bank credit facilities and the issuance of $200 million in new senior subordinated notes, Hayes said.

The transaction, which has been approved by the Hayes board of directors, is expected to be completed by the end of the second quarter, at which time Lemmerz, based in Konigswinter, Germany, will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Hayes, Hayes said.
The combined company will be named Hayes Lemmerz International Inc. It will have estimated annual sales of about $1.4 billion, Hayes said.
Ron Cucuz, 52, chairman and chief executive officer of Hayes, will continue as president, chairman and chief executive officer.
Horst Kukwa-Lemmerz, 53, who will retire from his position as president of Lemmerz, will serve as vice chairman of Hayes and as chairman of Hayes Europe, Hayes said.
Hayes shares were up 1/8 at 21-1/2 Friday.
